The '''Mining Guild''', located in and beneath [[Falador]], is a guild for expert miners available to players with at least 60 [[Mining]] (can be [[Temporary skill boost#Mining|boosted]]). The [[List of mines|mine]] is accessible from either the Mining Guild's above-ground complex in the south-east of the city, or through the gate at the southern end of the [[Dwarven Mine]]. Both of these entrances are guarded by [[Dwarf (Mining Guild)|dwarves]] who will answer questions about the guild and stop players without the requirements from entering the guild. The guildmaster, [[Gadrin]], also sells the [[Mining cape]] to those who have achieved level 99 Mining.

This [[List of mines|mine]] is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for [[Iron rocks#Power-mining Locations|power-mining]].

==Transportation==
[[File:Mining Guild underground entrance.png|thumb|200px|The entrance to the Mining Guild from the [[Dwarven Mine]].]]
*Players may use a [[skills necklace]] to teleport to the underground entrance.
*Casting [[Falador Teleport]] will transport a player to the [[Falador]] town square, just north-west of the guild entrance.
*The [[Keldagrim mine cart system]] can be used to travel to the north-west corner of the [[Dwarven Mine]]. From there, players can follow the mines south until they reach the underground entrance.
* The [[Explorer's ring 2]], [[Explorer's ring 3|3]], and [[Explorer's ring 4|4]] will teleport you into the cabbage field south of the Falador [[Dwarven Mine]] entrance.

[[File:Mining Guild interior.png|thumb|Inside the Mining Guild.]]
In addition, there are two shops found in the centre: [[Yarsul's Prodigious Pickaxes]], which sells [[pickaxes]], and [[Hendor's Awesome Ores]], which sells [[ores]] (with zero stock).

There is an exit to the east, which leads to the [[Motherlode Mine]]. As the Motherlode Mine is a members-only area, using this exit requires the player be on a [[member]]s' world.

===Members' area===
[[File:Mining Guild member's area.png|thumb|250px|Inside the Mining Guild's members-only area.]]

While inside this area of the guild, players will receive an invisible +7 level boost to their Mining. This boost will stack with any existing boosts the player already has, such as the visible +3 boost from using the [[dragon pickaxe]]'s [[special attack]] as well as the invisible +4 boost from the [[celestial ring]]/[[celestial signet]], though visible boosts are capped to level 99.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1375844352098975753|date=27 March 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98237|archivedate=29 March 2021|quote=I did a little more trawling of the code, and can confirm that the visible stat is now treated as 99 if it's above 99 - that is a recent change. It seems to have been applied to Mining, Fishing and Woodcutting.}} However, the invisible boost '''will not''' allow a player to perform actions above their base level. In addition, the [[respawn]] time for rocks mined in this area is halved.

This area is the only location in which players can mine [[amethyst crystals]] (with the mining area west of the bank requiring completion of the [[Falador Diary#Elite|elite Falador Diary]]). Players must speak to [[Belona]] to access the diary-only mining area.

Mining any of the rocks in this area gives a chance of receiving [[unidentified minerals]]. These can be traded in for [[mining gloves]] or [[superior mining gloves]] from [[Belona]]'s shop, [[Mining Guild Mineral Exchange]]. If players do not want to receive them, they can be disabled by right-clicking "Toggle-minerals" on Belona.

When using an [[infernal pickaxe]] in the members area of the Mining Guild, the [[Smithing]] effect will '''NOT''' negate the ability to receive [[unidentified minerals]] upon its [[proc]].

==== Bank chest ====
There is also a [[bank chest]], a [[bank deposit box]], and a [[poll booth]] inside the guild. The chest was added in 2017 alongside amethyst.

==Collection log==
There are 3 [[collection log]] items that are exclusive to the Mining Guild. These gloves can be bought from [[Belona]] in exchange for [[unidentified minerals]].

* The free-to-play area now also contains 2 Adamantite and 4 Iron rocks. Two new shops have been added for pickaxes and ores. The ore shop has no stock by default.
* A members-only area has been added with: a bank, a deposit box, a poll booth, 8 Iron rocks, 20 Coal rocks, 10 Mithril rocks, 8 Adamantite rocks, and 2 Runite rocks.
* The members-only Mining Guild area has two more passive bonuses: rocks respawn 50% faster, and you get an invisible +7 Mining level boost. This boost helps players mine ores more successfully, but doesn't unlock higher-level rocks. It also stacks with other Mining boosts.
